Ukuthi isivuno senzelwe ama-pods amasha noma ubhontshisi obugociwe kushintsha ukuthi kubaluleke kangakanani ukulimala kwendawo.
Before choosing a beetle treatment, iden: Ngaphambi kokukhetha ukwelashwa kwebhungane, thola isitshalo esithwala isinambuzane. Umuntu omdala onemigqa eqabungeni lezambane kanye nebhungane elincanyana ngaphakathi kwembali ye-squash libiza amasheke ahlukene. Irekhodi eliwusizo lesampula lihlanganisa sonke isitshalo esisingethe kanye nombono ocacile womhlane webhungane.
Before picking the rotten peach, notice: Ngaphambi kokukha ipentshisi elibolile, qaphela ukuthi yiluphi uhlangothi olubheke umakhelwane walo. Hlola indawo oxhumene kuyo kuqala, bese uphendulela umakhelwane ukuze abheke ukulimala kwesibili. Susa izithelo ezomisiwe nasebusika, lapho amagatsha engenalutho futhi ama-mummies amadala kulula ukubona.
Before pruning, check the opposite side: Ngaphambi kokuthena, hlola uhlangothi oluphambene nesitshalo ngokuphakama okufanayo. Ukusatshalaliswa kungase kuveze ukuthi yimaphi amaqabunga agqitshwe amagatsha noma izimbiza ezingomakhelwane. Uma ucela ukuhlonza, faka igama lesitshalo kanye nokubukwa kokubili kwesilonda sangaphambi kwesikhathi ngenkathi kusenezicubu eziluhlaza ezisizungezile.
Before removing a gall, examine the othe: Ngaphambi kokukhipha inyongo, hlola amanye amaqabunga kuhlumela elisha elifanayo. Uma i-blade eyodwa kuphela ibe yindilinga ephaphathekile futhi omakhelwane bayo bajwayele ukumila, bhala lokho kusatshalaliswa. Amahlamvu awugqinsi afanayo kuyo yonke i-camellia esunguliwe adinga ukubheka izici ezivamile ze-cultivar kuqala.
Before removing a seedling cover, count: Ngaphambi kokukhipha isembozo sezithombo, bala amaqabunga anempilo ezitshalweni ezimbalwa eziphawuliwe. Hlola lezo zitshalo uma amabhungane esekwazi ukufinyelela kuzo. Ukulahleka kweqabunga lembewu eliningi esitshalweni esincane sokufakelwa kudinga ukunakwa ngokushesha kunokuluma okumbalwa okusabalele emvinini oqhakaza izimbali.
Before removing a striped beetle, identi: Ngaphambi kokukhipha ibhungane elinemithende, hlonza isitshalo esisingethe bese ubheka ukudla okusha kuso. Uma umuntu omdala ephumula nje eduze kwembobo endala, yithathe isithombe bese uhlola kabusha iqabunga ngaphambi kokunquma ukulawula.
Before touching the plant, look along a: Ngaphambi kokuthinta isitshalo, bheka eduze kweqabunga elibanjwe ezingeni lamehlo. Lezi zinambuzane ezincane zivame ukuhlala nezimpiko ezehlela phezu komzimba omncane; ama-nymphs awanawo amaphiko aphelele. Uma isinambuzane siphuma, jika amaqabunga angomakhelwane kancane. Isithombe esithathwe eceleni ngenkathi iphumule siwusizo kakhulu kunokubala izinambuzane ezindizayo lapho igatsha lonke linyakaziswa.
Black scurf consists of irregular dark s: I-scurf emnyama iqukethe izakhiwo zokusinda ezimnyama ezingaphezulu. Ku-tuber ebekelwe ukuhlolwa, khipha eyodwa ngozipho bese uhlola ukuthi isikhumba esiqinile singaphansi yini.
Black scurf leaves dark deposits on top: I-scurf emnyama ishiya amadiphozithi amnyama phezu kwesikhumba. Uqweqwe oluyimpushana lungaveza imigodi evulekile enemiphetho emagebhugebhu. Uma umehluko ubalulekile endabeni yembewu, gcina amasampula angakanqunywa emtholampilo.
Black vine weevils cause two kinds of in: Ama-weevils omvini omnyama abangela izinhlobo ezimbili zokulimala ekutshalweni kokuhlobisa. Abantu abadala bahlafuna emaphethelweni amaqabunga ebusuku. Izibungu eziphaphathekile zikhula emhlabathini, lapho ukudla kungonakalisa izimpande, ikakhulukazi ebhodweni lasenkulisa.

Blue-green mold beneath garlic bulb wrap: Isikhunta esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka esingaphansi kwama-wrappers we-garlic bulb

Broad plaques revealed beneath oak bark: Izingcwecwe ezibanzi ezivezwa ngaphansi kwegxolo le-oki zifanelwe ukubhekisiswa lapho zilandela isomiso esithatha isikhathi eside. Thola ukuthi i-plaque lisesithweni esifile, esithweni esisaphila noma esiqwini esikhulu.

Browning starts at the tip and moves inw: I-Browning iqala phezulu bese ingena ngaphakathi. Unqenqema olumnyama oluthambile eqabungeni enhlabathini emanzi luyingxenye yekhasi lomhlahlandlela we-black-margin.
Brush loose frass from the outside of a: Gcoba ama-frass axegayo ngaphandle kwesiqu esisolwayo ngaphandle kokukhulisa imbobo. Bud stimulation, pests and disease can a: Ukugqugquzelwa kwamahlumela, izinambuzane kanye nezifo kungathinta i-branching. Thatha isithombe kokubili isitshalo sonke kanye neqoqo ukuze uhlonzwe.
Callus and galls may look alike. Avoid c: I-Callus ne-gall ingase ibukeke ngokufanayo. Gwema ukusika ekuvuvukeni okungaziwa futhi ufune ukuhlonza uhlobo lwesilwane.

Check a flagged twig below the egg slits: Hlola igatsha elihlatshwe umkhosi ngezansi kwemiklebhu yeqanda ukuze uthole ukuhlangana okuqinile negatsha lalo elingumzali. Check a fresh brown lesion and any spent: Hlola isilonda esisha esinsundu kanye nanoma iyiphi i-petal esetshenziswe ngaso. Ukukhula okumpunga okufiphele ezicutshini ezilimele kusekela isikhunta esimpunga, ikakhulukazi ezimeni eziswakeme; ukukhula kungase kungabi khona lapho izicubu zomile.
Check a lower leaf with attached immatur: Hlola iqabunga eliphansi elinezimpukane ezingavuthiwe ezinamathele ngisho nalapho kuvuka abantu abadala abambalwa esitshalweni. Ukwehla kwabantu abadala abandizayo ngemva kokubamba kuyakhuthaza, kodwa amakoloni amasha kulawo maqabunga abonisa ukuthi lesi sitshalo sisadinga ukulandelelwa.
Check adjacent vines for newly laid clus: Bheka imivini eseduze ukuthola amaqoqo asanda kubekwa. Landela ngomkhondo ukuthi amaqabunga amasha ahlala eqondile yini ngenkathi uqhubeka nokubheka ama-nymphs acashe ngaphansi kwe-canopy.
Check again when the branch has dried. T: Hlola futhi uma igatsha lomile. Izilinganiso zingancipha kakhulu ngenkathi inyongo yokhuni ihlala endaweni. I-sap ivamise ukwehlela phansi kusukela ekhefini; ayiveli ngokuphindaphindiwe njengeqembu elihlelekile lezimpondo eziphuma emigodini enenyongo eyindilinga.
Check an untouched shoot before attribut: Hlola ihlumela elingakathintwa ngaphambi kokuthi ifilimu ihlobene nesikhunta. Izinsalela ze-spray zingalandela imigqa yokuvuza, kuyilapho ezinye izitshalo ngokwemvelo zithwala indawo ene-waxy ephaphathekile kwezinye iziqu ezinempilo.
Check another leaf of similar age on the: Hlola elinye iqabunga leminyaka efanayo esitshalweni esifanayo. Qhathanisa umbala we-vein obonakalayo ekukhanyeni kwasemini; ukubamba iqabunga phezulu efasiteleni elikhanyayo kungenza ihaba imithambo yalo ephaphathekile.
Check both ends of the swelling for a na: Hlola imikhawulo yomibili yokuvuvukala ukuthola umsele omncane oshiywe uthayi noma ilebula. Izicubu zingase ziqhume kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zokuthintwa. I-graft union nayo ingashiya umthungo ophikelelayo ekuphakameni okungaguquki. Thatha isithombe sonke isitshalo kanye nenhlabathi ukuze ulondoloze lowo mongo. Khipha uthayi obophayo ngaphandle kokusika esicutshini esikhulisiwe.
Check drainage and the recent feeding hi: Hlola ukugeleza kwamanzi kanye nomlando wokuphakela wakamuva ngaphambi kokwengeza umanyolo. Emibhedeni yasengadini, ukuhlolwa kwenhlabathi kungaqondisa ukukhetha kokuchitshiyelwa.
Check drainage as well as watering frequ: Hlola amanzi kanye nemvamisa yokunisela. Uma isitsha simi ebhodweni elingaphandle elivalekile, umquba ungahlala ugcwele ngisho noma ubuso bawo bubukeka bomile. Check each hollyhock stalk growing from: Hlola isiqu se-hollyhock esikhula kumqhele ofanayo bese uqopha iqabunga elithinteke kakhulu ngokuhlukana kwelinye. Ukuhlanganisa iziqu eziningana zibe isilinganiso esisodwa sobude kungafihla isiqu esisha esithintekile.
Check for brittle tips, widening margins: Hlola amathiphu ama-brittle, amamajini anwebekayo kanye namadiphozithi amaminerali acwebezelayo azungeze unqenqema lwebhodwe.
Check for fresh feeding marks on young l: Bheka izimpawu zokuncelisa emaqabunga amancane. Uma ukuhlanekezela kuqhubeka ngemva kokuhamba kwezinambuzane, funa ukuxilongwa okuqondene nomsingathi.
Check for one-sided development and note: Hlola ukukhula kohlangothi olulodwa futhi uqaphele isimo sezulu sesikhathi sokuqhakaza kanye nanoma yiziphi izimpawu zamaqabunga.
Check freshly notched leaf margins in th: Bheka amaphethelo amaqabunga amasha kusihlwa bese ubheka umuntu omdala onamfisha esitshalweni esithintekile.
Check fruit, nearby leaves and young ste: Hlola izithelo, amaqabunga aseduze kanye neziqu ezincane esihlahleni esisodwa. Thatha izithombe zombili izinhlangothi zeqabunga elinamabala uma kungenzeka. Isibazi esisodwa esidala sokuhlikihlwa emeveni sinezinkomba ezimbalwa zokuxilonga kunezilonda ezifanayo ezithweni eziningana.
Check how much healthy foliage remains b: Hlola ukuthi mangakanani amahlamvu anempilo asele ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo sokuthi uzosusa ini. Qaphela ukuthi ingabe umjunipha oseduze unokuvuvuka okungavamile; ubukhona bawo buyisisekelo esiwusizo, kodwa akukona ngokwako ukukhomba imbangela.
Check leaves on the same tree for olive: Hlola amaqabunga esihlahleni esifanayo ukuthola amachashaza omnqumo noma ansundu kanye nokuwa kwamaqabunga okuqala. Ukulimala okubushelelezi ngaphansi kwesikhumba esingaguquki noma imbobo eyodwa eholela enkabeni kuphakamisa imbangela ehlukile.

Izinhlamvu ezomile kanye nezimpande ezilimele ziphazamisa ukulethwa kwe-calcium esithelweni esikhulayo, nalapho i-calcium yomhlabathi yanele khona. Gcina umswakama ungashintshi futhi umboze nge-mulch ngemva kokuchelela.
Check moisture below the surface, near t: Hlola umswakama ngaphansi kwendawo, eduze nezimpande ezisebenzayo. Check moisture in the root zone and see: Hlola umswakama endaweni yezimpande futhi ubone ukuthi izimbali kuphela ezibheke isifudumezi, iwindi elishisayo noma umoya owomile ziyathinteka. Susa ama-blooms asetshenzisiwe uma imbewu ingafunwa.
Check more than the largest patch. Older: Hlola ngaphezu kwepeshi enkulu. Izikhungo ezindala zingase zidabuke noma zibe mhlophe, zifihle umphetho wokuqala futhi zinikeze isilonda esifanayo ukubukeka okuhluke kakhulu. Uma ucela ukuhlonza, faka igama lesitshalo kanye nokubukwa kokubili kwesilonda sangaphambi kwesikhathi ngenkathi kusenezicubu eziluhlaza ezisizungezile.
Check nearby fruit and young twigs. This: Hlola izithelo eziseduze namagatsha amancane. Lokhu kugqwala kuvame ukuthinta lezo zingxenye. Amachashaza ambalwa amaqabunga awolintshi ewodwa awacacisi kangako ngoba ukugqwala okuningana okuhlobene kushintshana phakathi komjunipha kanye nabasingathi be-rose-family.
Hlola amaqabunga aseduze ukuze uthole ama-stippling amasha. Amachashaza amadala asala ngisho nangemva kokuba izimbuzane sezilawulekile.
Check nearby leaves for new pale, tent-s: Bheka amahlamvu aseduze ukuze uthole iziqephu ezintsha eziphaphathekile, ezimise okwetende, ikakhulukazi emithanjeni engaphansi.
Check nearby mallows as well as the holl: Hlola ama-mallows aseduze kanye ne-hollyhock. Indawo emnyama eyisicaba ngaphandle kwendawo ephansi ephakanyisiwe inikeza ukusekelwa okuncane kokugqwala.
Check newly opened buds and fresh upper: Hlola amaqabunga asanda kuvulwa kanye namaqabunga angaphezulu amasha. Abantu abadala bangandiza besuka ezindaweni ezizungezile, ngakho ukuthola ibhungane erozini akusitholi indawo lapho izibungu lidla khona.
Hlola abanye abagijimi eduze naphansi. Buka ama-frass amasha ngaphambi kokuwohloka kwawo wonke umvini, njengoba i-wilt ethuthukisiwe ingavela ngemva kokulimala okukhulu kwangaphakathi.
Check previously clean young leaves for: Hlola amaqabunga ahlanzekile ngaphambilini ukuze uthole izikali ezisanda kuzinza. Izembozo ezingenalutho zingahlala emaqabunga amadala ngemva kokufa kwezinambuzane.
Check recovery above ground between wate: Hlola ukululama ngaphezu komhlabathi phakathi kokunisela. Uma umqhele uthambisa noma izitshalo ezimbalwa ezabelana ngethreyi lokunisela ziyehla ndawonye, ​​hlukanisa amabhodwe futhi ufune usizo lokuhlonza imbangela ngaphambi kokusebenzisa kabusha imiksi.
Check several blades in different patche: Hlola ama-blades amaningana kuma-patches ahlukene. Check several caterpillars before decidi: Hlola amacimbi amaningana ngaphambi kokunquma. Izikelemu zeklabishi ezivela kwamanye amazwe zibukeka zithambile, futhi amalokhi eklabishi angena maphakathi nomzimba njengoba ehamba.
Check several newly opened flowers on th: Hlola izimbali ezimbalwa ezisanda kuvulwa esitshalweni esisodwa. Thatha izithombe ze-anthers endaweni kanye namaqabunga nembali yonke. Ubunikazi bekamu bubalulekile uma kuqanjwa ukhunta oluhlobene.
Check shortly after petal fall next spri: Hlola ngokushesha ngemva kokuwa kwe-petal entwasahlobo elandelayo. Thatha izithombe zezimayini zisencane bese ubhala ukuthi yiziphi izihlahla ezikhombisa umonakalo. Kamuva, qhathanisa isithelo esiphawuliwe esisekhona nalowo mlando wasendulo.
Check sunny upper foliage and open flowe: Bheka amahlamvu aphezulu anelanga nezimbali ezivulekile ukuze uthole amaqembu amabhungane. Check that the inner pot drains freely a: Hlola ukuthi ibhodwe elingaphakathi likhipha amanzi ngokukhululekile futhi lingenalutho namanzi avalelwe ebhodweni elimboziwe. Check that the swelling replaces an indi: Hlola ukuthi ukuvuvukala kuthatha indawo yesithelo ngasinye. Iqoqo lama-aphid lihlala phezulu, kuyilapho lesi sakhiwo siqhubeka nezicubu zesitshalo. Ukuhlonzwa kosokhaya kusiza ukunciphisa inyongo ehilelekile.
Check the base of each dry leaf. A compl: Hlola isisekelo seqabunga ngalinye elomile. Check the blossom end and the places whe: Hlola ukuphela kwembali kanye nezindawo lapho ama-apula amabili athintana khona. Izinto ezinsundu ngokugqagqene ezizungeze imbobo zingamaka indawo yokungena kwesibungu senundu.
Check the blossom-end recess on apples t: Hlola ikhefu le-blossom-end kuma-apula abukeka enomsindo ohlangothini. Isibungu singangena lapho futhi sishiye umonakalo omncane osobala esihlathini. Hlola amaconsi asaqala kanye nezithelo ezilengayo uma ulinganisela ukuthi isivuno sithinteke kangakanani.
Check the buds that stayed closed after: Hlola ama-buds ahlala evaliwe ngemva kokuqhakaza kwama-rhododendron angomakhelwane. Ihlumela lembali elifile, elimpunga elimbozwe ngezikhonkwane ezincane ezimnyama liwuphawu lokuqhuma kwamahlamvu.
Check the cachepot for standing water. C: Hlola i-cachepot ukuze uthole amanzi amile. Qhathanisa izimpande eziqinile nezingxenye ungqimba lwazo lwangaphandle olushelelayo lapho lithintwa.
Check the crotches of cherry and ornamen: Bheka ama-crotches ama-cherry namagatsha e-crabapple okuhlobisa njengoba izihlahla ziphuma. Check the cultivar description. Some app: Hlola incazelo ye-cultivar. Amanye ama-apula ngokwemvelo enza i-russet ebanzi. Ezinhlotsheni ezijwayelekile ezibushelelezi, ukuchayeka ezimeni ezimanzi noma ukulimala kwesifutho lapho izithelo zisencane kungasiza ukuchaza iphethini yesizini ethile.
Check the current season's shoot for new: Hlola ukushutha kwesizini yamanje ukuze uthole amakhava amasha. Amakhava angenalutho esiqwini esidala angahlala esizini ezayo.
Check the deeper mix for persistent wetn: Hlola ingxube ejulile ukuze ubone ukuba manzi okuqhubekayo, i-cachepot yamanzi avaleleke kanye namahlamvu aphezulu ukuze uthole izinguquko.
Check the exact height of a pale mark ag: Hlola ubude obuqondile bophawu oluphaphathekile esigxotsheni, unqenqema lwebhodwe noma iqabunga elingumakhelwane elinomphetho oqinile. Check the leaf beneath an infested branc: Bheka iqabunga ngaphansi kwegatsha elihlaselwe yizinyosi ezinamathelayo. If declining conifers could fall on a pa: Uma ama-conifers awehlayo angawela endleleni noma esakhiweni, hlala ngaphandle kokufinyelela kwawo. Rekhoda indawo ye-arborist oqeqeshiwe.

If several plants in one bed grow poorly: Uma izitshalo ezimbalwa embhedeni owodwa zikhula kabi futhi zinamafindo afanayo, buza isevisi yokuxilonga ukuthi iyazidinga yini izimpande kanye nomhlabathi oyizungezile. If sticky droplets return to cleaned fol: Uma amaconsi anamathelayo ebuyela emaqabunga ahlanzekile, hlola umthombo ongaphezulu futhi ngisho noma ifilimu elimnyama lisazokhula kabusha.
If that pattern fits, examine fluctuatio: Uma lelo phethini lifanelana, hlola ukushintshashintsha komswakama womhlabathi ngesikhathi sokwandiswa kwesithelo ngaphambi kokwengeza umanyolo. If the plum has several trunks, start at: Uma iplamu ineziqu ezimbalwa, qala kufindo elilodwa elimnyama bese ulandelela igatsha lalo phansi esiqwini ngaphambi kokulimaka ukuze lithenwe. Amagatsha awelayo angenza ihlumela elinempilo libonakale lithwele ifindo.
If the pot is wet inside a decorative co: Uma ibhodwe limanzi ngaphakathi kwekhava yokuhlobisa, likhiphe futhi ulivumele likhiphe ngokukhululekile. Bheka ukuthi amanzi angaphuma yini ngemigodi. If the root ball is dry, water slowly un: Uma impande yomile, manzisa kancane kancane ize imanziswe, bese uyikhipha. Bheka ukululama emaqabunga amancane.

Inspect ripening peaches where fruit tou: Hlola amapentshisi avuthwa lapho kuthintwa khona isithelo noma isikhumba silimele. Ukubola okunsundu kungaqala njengepheshi elithambile elinsundu futhi kwande kuze kube yilapho iningi lepentshisi lithinteka.
Inspect rough bark beneath a thinning cr: Hlola amagxolo amaholoholo ngaphansi komqhele ozacile phakathi nosuku. Izibungu ezinkulu zingakhosela lapho ngaphambi kokuba zibuye zizodla ebusuku. Ubulongwe obungaphansi kwamagatsha busiza ekutholeni ingxenye esebenzayo yesihlahla esikhulu.
Inspect several berries on a cluster. A: Hlola amajikijolo ambalwa kuqoqo. Indawo encane eshone phansi enendawo ephaphathekile kanye nomphetho omnyama inganikeza i-anthracnose yamagilebhisi ukubukeka kwayo okujwayelekile njengeso lenyoni.
Inspect several intact swellings before: Hlola ukuvuvukala okuningana okungaguquki ngaphambi kokuvula okukodwa. Umbala nokuhlelwa kwezinyongo ezingaguquki kanye nobunikazi bomsingathi kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukuhlonza. Inspect several shoot tips. Distinguish: Hlola amathiphu ambalwa wokuthwebula. Hlukanisa amahlamvu avamile abomvu kusukela kuzicubu ezijiyile noma ezijiyile.
Inspect shaded dead twigs and old prunin: Hlola amagatsha afile anomthunzi kanye nezigaxa ezindala zokuthena ukuze uthole amakhushini angama-salmon anosayizi wephinikhodi. Inspect tender shoots for groups of pear: Hlola amahlumela amathenda ukuze uthole amaqembu ezinambuzane ezimise okwepheya. Ngelensi yesandla, bheka amashubhu amabili amancane eduze nengemuva lesisu. Ama-aphid amadala angaba namaphiko, ngakho-ke umuntu ondizayo akawakhiphi.

Inspect the base of a second green fruit: Hlola isisekelo sesithelo sesibili esiluhlaza esisanda kuqala ukwanda. I-lobe ebekwe endaweni engafanele kakade ibonakala kuleso sigaba ikhomba ukukhula kwembali. Inspect the crown from the ground and re: Hlola umqhele osuka phansi bese ubhala ukuthi amahlamvu afile aqala yini emagatsheni aphezulu. Bheka ukumbiwa kwakamuva, isomiso, ukuminyana noma ukulahlekelwa okuphindaphindiwe kwamaqabunga okungenzeka ukuthi kwenze isihlahla sibe buthaka.
Inspect the dense center of the plant af: Hlola isikhungo esiminyene sesitshalo ngemva kokuba amaqabunga angaphandle omile. Inspect the distribution and nearby leav: Hlola ukusatshalaliswa kanye namahlamvu aseduze. Qhathanisa ukuqhakaza kwe-waxy okuvamile kwe-cultivar nama-patches asanda kuvela angavamile.
Inspect the edges of the holes. A dead r: Hlola emaphethelweni emigodi. Unqenqema olufile kanye namabala aseduze anezikhungo eziqinile asikisela ukuthi kuwile izicubu; imiphetho ephukile ingabonisa ukuhlafuna.
Inspect the edges with a magnifier for i: Hlola imiphetho ngesikhulisi ukuze uthole izinambuzane ezingazodwana noma imicu ye-cottony efakwe emalungeni amaqabunga. Lapho izinsalela zizwakala khona, bheka amaqabunga akhiqizwe ngemva kokushintshela ekuniseleni ezingeni lomhlabathi. Shiya isiqeshana sangempela sibonakale ukuze siqhathaniswe.
Inspect the exposed surface from the gro: Hlola indawo eveziwe kusukela phansi. Isikhungo esinamabala kanye nama-cushions aphakanyisiwe ampunga noma amnyama asiza ukuhlukanisa i-canker engapheli ne-scrape entsha.
Inspect the freshest damaged foliage on: Hlola amahlamvu awonakele kakhulu ku-mint noma kwenye imifino. Amachashaza amancane ashonile angahlangana njengoba iqabunga likhula; izikhungo ezomisiwe ngezinye izikhathi ziyawa. Hlola iziqu ezimbalwa ezingomakhelwane ngaphambi kokukha amaqabunga ekhishini. Lezi zinambuzane ezisebenzayo zingase zisuke ehlumeni lokuqala olithintayo, ngakho ukuhlola kuphela iqabunga elihlutshiwe kamuva kungase kukushiye namachashaza kodwa kungabikho sinambuzane ongasibona.
Inspect the husk before stripping a dama: Hlola ikhoba ngaphambi kokukhumula indlebe eyonakele. Qaphela ukuthi ukuvuvukala kuyaliphusha yini ikhoba ngaphakathi, noma isilwane silidabule ikhoba futhi sidle imigqa yezinhlamvu ezingavamile. Lezi zingabukeka zifana ngaphandle.
Inspect the leaf axil, the angle where t: Hlola i-axil yeqabunga, i-engeli lapho isiqu seqabunga sihlangana nesiqu. Futhi hlola i-underside eduze ne-midrib. Bheka ngaphansi kwesigaxa se-waxy isinambuzane esimise okweqanda njengalesi esisesithombeni.
Inspect the lowest green hollyhock leave: Hlola amaqabunga e-hollyhock aluhlaza aphansi kakhulu kuqala. Amachashazi aphuzi ngokuphaphathekile phezulu avame ukufana nama-pustules ansundu aphakanyisiwe wesinamoni ngaphansi. Maka ukuphakama kweqabunga eliphakeme kakhulu elithintekile lapho uqala ukuhlola isitshalo. Ukuhlola kamuva kungase kuhlukanise ukusabalala okusha kuma-pustules ayekhona ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Inspect the midrib and the underside of: Hlola i-midrib ne-underside yeqabunga ngelensi yesandla. I-armored scale inesihlangu esingaphakanyiswa ngokuhlukana nesinambuzane. Isembozo sesikali esithambile siyingxenye yomzimba wayo; shiya amaqhubu anamathele aqinile ukuze akhonjwe.
Inspect the next flowers as they open an: Hlola izimbali ezilandelayo njengoba zivuleka futhi uqhathanise inani lokuhlafunwa okusha. Ukubamba okuncane ngaphandle kokulimala okusha kungabonisa umsebenzi ojwayelekile wasengadini.
Inspect the next unopened leaf without f: Hlola iqabunga elilandelayo elingavuliwe ngaphandle kokulihlukanisa. I-blade eyodwa ehlanekezelwe ene-crease efana nesigxobo noma uthayi iphakamisa ukuthikamezeka ngokomzimba. Ukuhlanekezela okuphindaphindiwe kumathiphu ambalwa wokuthwebula agunyaza ukuhlola ukugoqa kwezinambuzane kanye nokubuyekeza noma yikuphi ukuchayeka kwesifutho kwakamuva eduze.
Inspect the plant before washing or movi: Hlola isitshalo ngaphambi kokusigeza noma ukusihambisa. Qala lapho umonakalo ubukeka usha kakhulu futhi uphendule iqabunga ngaphandle kokunyakazisa ihlumela. Faka okunamathiselwe esiqwini ekuhloleni kwakho. Ilensi yesandla noma isithombe sefoni esiseduze singadalula imininingwane engageja isithombe saso sonke isitshalo.
Inspect the same lot again for enlarging: Hlola inkatho efanayo futhi ukuze ukhulise amabala nokushwabana. Qaphela ukuthi amamaki abesevele ekhona yini ngesikhathi sokuvuna; izilonda obekunzima ukuzibona ngaleso sikhathi zingase zibonakale ngemva kwesikhathi esibekiwe.
Inspect the shaded underside in good lig: Hlola ingaphansi elinomthunzi ngokukhanya okuhle. Uthuli oluhlezi phezu kwe-blade lungafihla umehluko phakathi kwezindawo zokuphakela eziphaphathekile nezindawo ezincane zezicubu ezifile. Uma ucela ukuhlonza, faka igama lesitshalo kanye nokubukwa kokubili kwesilonda sangaphambi kwesikhathi ngenkathi kusenezicubu eziluhlaza ezisizungezile.
Inspect the sheltered side of a leaf sta: Hlola uhlangothi oluvikelekile lwesiqu seqabunga kanye nokugoqa eduze kwehlumela eliseduze. Bheka isinambuzane esiyisiyingi esihlukile ngaphansi kwe-wax. Ngemva kokuhlanza i-node efinyelelekayo, phinda uvakashele leyo ndawo futhi uhlole ihlumela elalihlanzekile ngaphambilini. Izinambuzane ezintsha kuhlumela oluhlanzekile ziwubufakazi obungcono bokuqhubeka komsebenzi kune-wax eshiywe esiqwini esidala.
Inspect the side of a beetle for small w: Hlola uhlangothi lwebhungane ukuze uthole izigaxa ezincane ezimhlophe eduze kwesisu salo ngaphansi kwezembozo zamaphiko ethusi. Hlanganisa lokhu nomzimba wayo oluhlaza okwensimbi lapho uyikhomba.
Inspect the small cone-like female struc: Hlola izakhiwo zowesifazane ezincane ezifana nekhoni ku-alder. Amaphrojekthi aphumayo ayisicaba, amise okolimi ukusuka phakathi kwezikali zawo. Ingase ibe luhlaza ekuqaleni, ibebomvu futhi ekugcineni ibe nsundu yomile.
Inspect the small covers along veins or: Hlola izembozo ezincane ngasemithanjeni noma eziqwini ezincane, bese ubheka izinambuzane ezingasenalutho kanye namaphuphu asanda kuzinza ekukhuleni okusha.
Inspect the stalk, tassel and other ears: Hlola isiqu, intshakaza nezinye izindlebe esitshalweni esisodwa, bese ubheka izitshalo ezingomakhelwane. Qaphela ukuthi indlebe eyodwa kuphela ethintekile noma umonakalo usabalele. Uma ukhipha inyongo esichibini sasekhaya, yiphathe ngobumnene ngaphambi kokuba ibhodloke futhi uqoqe okuxekethile okuthintekile.
Inspect the underside directly beneath a: Hlola i-underside ngqo ngaphansi kwesiqeshana esinama-stippled. Rekhoda noma yimaphi amachashazi anyakazayo, izikhumba ezicijile noma ama-webbing amahle, bese uhlola iqabunga elingalimele ukuze uqhathanise ngaphambi kokukhetha ukwelashwa.
Inspect the underside for fine webs and: Hlola i-underside ukuze uthole ama-web amahle namachashazi anyakazayo, kanye nendawo engaphezulu ukuze ubone ukuthi akukho okuphaphathekile yini.
Inspect the underside for fuzzy growth a: Hlola indawo engaphansi ukuze uthole ukukhula okufiphele futhi ubone ukuthi imithambo ibophe izindawo eziguqukile.
Inspect the underside of a young shoot a: Hlola ingaphansi lehlumela elincane kanye nendawo eseceleni kwehlumela ngalinye. Qopha ukuthi izinto ezimhlophe zakha ifilimu eqhubekayo noma ama-tufts amancane ahlukene emajoyini.
Inspect the undersides of several leaves: Hlola izinhlangothi ezingaphansi zamaqabunga amaningana, ikakhulukazi eduze nemithambo. Sekela iqabunga ngalinye lapho uliphendula ukuze ugweme ukuhlwitha i-petiole.
Inspect the wall of a previous season's: Hlola udonga lwenyongo yesizini edlule ngaphambi kokuyibala njengehlalwe. Ukuvuleka kungase kubonise ukuvela noma ukuvakasha kwenyoni. Ukuze ufunde ukwakheka kwenyongo yamanje, phawula isiqu esiluhlaza ngenkathi sisakhula bese ubhala ukuthi ukuvuvukala okusha kuyavela kulelo hlumela.
Inspect tissue beneath the mold, crowdin: Hlola izicubu ngaphansi kwesikhunta, eziminyene phakathi kwezithelo nezindawo ezilimele.
Inspect veins and leaf undersides for mo: Hlola imithambo nangaphansi kweqabunga ukuze uthole izibungu ezinyakazayo, amawebu amahle noma izikhumba eziphonsiwe.
Inspect young leaves after wet spells th: Hlola amaqabunga asemancane ngemva kokumanzisa entwasahlobo elandelayo. Rekhoda ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ezithintekayo ngaphambi kokukhetha izihlahla ezishintshayo, njengoba ukuba sengozini kuyehluka futhi izibazi ezikhona zizohlala zibonakala kuze kube sekuvuneni.
Iris borer injury changes position as th: Ukulimala kwe-iris borer kushintsha indawo lapho isibungu sikhula. Entwasahlobo umkhondo ungaba iqabunga elilodwa elimele. Hlola iqabunga kanye ne-rhizome enamathiselwe ndawonye ukuze wakhe kabusha lokho kuqhubekela phambili.

Is browning confined to older blooms? Ch: Ingabe i-browning igcina izimbali ezindala? Bheka imiqumbe engavuliwe kanye namaqabunga esiqwini esifanayo.
Is the original spot expanding, or are n: Ingabe indawo yokuqala iyakhula, noma amaqabunga amasha ayathinteka?

Judge by a root that slips its skin and: Yahlulela ngempande eshelelayo esikhumbeni sayo, engenamthombo, hhayi ngokuba mnyama kangakanani. Ikhowe eliyingxube yebhodwe lingelekhasi lomhlahlandlela wesikhunta esingaphezulu.
Judge recovery from the next true leaves: Gwema ukutholakala kwamaqabunga eqiniso alandelayo kanye nobude besiqu esisha ngaphezu kwamaqabunga embewu. Uma ukukhula okusha kuhlangene futhi kunempilo, shiya amaqabunga embewu ebunayo endaweni.

Judge the response from newly formed lea: Yahlulela impendulo evela emaqabungeni asanda kwakhiwa kanye nezingxenye zesiqu. Ukukhula okusha okuhlangene kuphakamisa intuthuko ngisho noma ingxenye yasekuqaleni eyeluliwe ihlala iyinde.
Keep a photograph of the whole crown as: Gcina isithombe somqhele wonke njengesisekelo. Ekuhloleni okulandelayo qhathanisa amahlumela aluhlaza aseduze futhi uhlole igatsha lesibili elihlatshwe umkhosi. Maka indawo emdwebeni ukuze amagxolo afanayo aphinde ahlolwe lapho amabhamuza ebonakala kakhulu.
Keep a picture of the earliest stage alo: Gcina isithombe sesiteji sakuqala eduze neso esibonisa ukuwa kwakamuva. Ukuze uthole isicelo sokukhomba, faka igama lokunqampuna nokuthi ingabe isiqeshana sasomile noma sasimanzi ngenkathi usibona okokuqala.
Keep affected tubers out of planting sto: Gcina izilimo eziyizigaxa ezithintekile zingangeni esitokweni sokutshala. Lebula umbhede nenqwaba yembewu ngokwehlukana; ukuthola ama-black crusts esivunweni esisodwa akukwazi ukunquma ngokwako ukuthi umthombo wokuqala bekuyinhlabathi noma imbewu yamazambane.
Keep contaminated soil on site. Remove i: Gcina inhlabathi engcolile esizeni. Susa izitshalo ezinegciwane kanye nomhlabathi ohlanzekile kumathuluzi namabhuzu ngaphambi kokuthuthela embhedeni ohlanzekile.
Keep functioning leaves on the tree. On: Gcina amaqabunga asebenzayo esihlahleni. Esigodini se-oki esinamandla, amabhamuza ahlakazekile ngokuvamile adinga ukubhekwa kunokwelashwa.

Keep people and vehicles away from the f: Gcina abantu nezimoto kude nendawo yokuwa uma isihlahla esithintekile singase sishaye okuhlosiwe. Hlela ukuhlolwa kwezihlahla eziqeqeshiwe.
Keep several intact pine needle bundles: Gcina izishuqulu ezimbalwa zezinaliti zikaphayini ezingashintshi esithombeni bese ubhala ukuthi zingaki izinaliti eziphuma emgodleni ngamunye. Izinaliti ezimbalwa ezixegayo zilahlekelwa yile nkomba yokuhlonza.
Keep soil and bulbs from the suspect pat: Gcina inhlabathi nama-bulbs asuka endaweni esolwayo ehlukene. Hlanza inhlabathi kumathuluzi nezicathulo kuleyo ndawo. Gwema ukonga ama-clove ekutshaleni okuthintekile njengesitoko sembewu.
Keep suspect grain, seed heads and hay a: Gcina okusanhlamvu okusolwayo, izinhloko zembewu notshani kude nemfuyo nokudla kwasendlini. Uma impahla ihloselwe ukuphakelwa noma ukugaywa, buza ilabhorethri yezolimo oqeqeshiwe noma umeluleki wesandiso ukuthi inkatho ingahlolwa kanjani.

Keep the same shrub under observation th: Gcina isihlahlana esifanayo ngaphansi kokubhekwa ehlobo nasentwasahlobo elandelayo. Ukulahlekelwa okukhulu kwamahlamvu okuphindaphindiwe kubaluleke kakhulu kunezimbobo ezimbalwa eziqhelile.
Keep this page for magnolia twigs. Wax o: Gcina leli khasi ukuze uthole amagatsha e-magnolia. I-wax kunoma yisiphi esinye isihlahla idinga ukuthi umsingathi ahlolwe ngaphambi kokuthi ingezwe lapha.
Keep this page for roses. Check the leaf: Gcina leli khasi ukuze uthole ama roses. Hlola ukuma kweqabunga ngaphambi kokwengeza isiqeshana esikhanyayo esivela kwesinye isihlahla.
Keep this page for sown seedlings. Yello: Gcina leli khasi ukuze uthole izithombo ezihlwanyelwe. Amaqabunga aphuzi esifanekiso sebhodwe elidala ayingxenye yekhasi lomhlahlandlela wamaqabunga afanayo.
Keep track of flowers opening in milder: Landelela izimbali ezivuleka esimweni sezulu esipholile. Uma izithelo ezivela kulezi zimbali zigcwala ngokulinganayo futhi ukuhlola kungatholi okuphakelayo okusebenzayo, isikhathi sisiza ukunciphisa imbangela yokuhlanekezela kwangaphambili.
Label a shoot that is still expanding, t: Lebula ihlumela elisakhula, bese uqhathanisa iqabunga lalo elincane elivuleke ngokuphelele neqabunga elivuthiwe ngaphansi kwalo. Ukuba phuzi phakathi kwemithambo eluhlaza egxile emaqabunga amancane kudinga ukuhlola i-pH yenhlabathi kanye nempilo yezimpande ngaphambi kokwengeza insimbi; ukuphuzi kweqabunga elidala kushintsha imibuzo enomsoco okufanele uyibuze.
Label a twig carrying both blistered and: Lebula igatsha elithwele kokubili amahlamvu e-oki anamabhamuza navamile ngaphambi kokuba i-canopy igcwale. Hlola ukuthi ingabe ukushaywa kwakamuva kwegatsha elifanayo nakho kunamabhamuza. Ukuxuba amaqabunga okuqala nakamuva esithombeni esisodwa kungenza izilonda ezindala zibukeke njengokuqubuka okusha.
Lace bugs feed beneath leaves. Record th: Izimbungulu ze-lace zidla ngaphansi kwamaqabunga. Rekhoda umsingathi neminyaka yamaqabunga, gcina izilwane ezidla ezinye futhi uhlole ukushaywa okulandelayo.
